content:
elaine: quick design thread 
elaine: TL;DR: proposal for run history previews - show a 1-line human summary for structured tool outputs, keep raw payload hidden behind an explicit control, and surface the function schema name as the contextual label. thoughts?

sam: yes to 1-line summary. example: "Invoice parsed total: $1,234 from: Stripe Parser". keep it compact but informative.

maya: agree on schema name as context. UX nit: avoid mixing too many separators. maybe use em dash: "InvoiceSummary — Total $1,234 " . also sentence case.

tom: accessibility note: the summary must be the accessible name. raw JSON should be aria-hidden unless expanded. also add a "Details" button with aria-expanded state.

lisa: button copy: prefer "Show details" / "Hide details" for clarity. screen readers announce state with aria-expanded. also make the button focusable via keyboard.

sam: good. what about cards that return multiple tools (tool chaining)? how show source attribution?

elainE: small typo in my last msg: meant "elaine" :) For chained results, show primary schema + a subtle pill: "via Stripe Parser". pill has title attr and copies full id on focus.

maya: implementation constraint: run history is virtualized. avoid rendering full details for offscreen rows. we can lazy-render details only when expanded or focused. use a live region to announce expansion.

tom: live region should debounce updates when arrowing. 200ms seems reasonable. also include result status in announcement: "Expanded: InvoiceSummary (success)".

lisa: accessibility tests: include NVDA + VoiceOver checks for the collapsed summary, expand control, and copy actions. also test with long schema names and very long numbers to ensure truncation works visually and for SR.

sam: copy behavior: "Copy summary" should copy the cleaned one-line text; a secondary "Copy raw JSON" for power users. confirm clipboard permission flows behave in iframe previews.

elainE: ui-bot: note branch "history-summary-a11y" created from elaine/ui. will post preview after CI.

maya: agreed on approach. action items:
- sam: implement summary label + copy controls (eta Wed)
- tom: debounce live region and SR strings (eta Tue)
- lisa: write acceptance tests and sample narration strings (eta Thu)
- elaine: update mocks and add pill microcopy (eta Tue)

elainE: thanks all :thumbsup:
